description.value:
Requirement a clear alpha to make an example of

Check one Intimidation roll vs. the highest Will DC present

Effect the whole group is off-guard to you and takes a −2 status penalty to Will saves and Perception checks against you and your allies, for 1 minute

Treat an entire group — a gang, a checkpoint crew, a boardroom — as a single Intimidation target.

cinderfall.incomplete: The off-guard portion needs no rule element (real pf2e ships condition-only outcomes as "rules": [], e.g. feint.json and terrifying-howl.json for the AoE case) and is applied manually via the description. The -2 status penalty to the group's Will saves/Perception is a stated number applied to external targets (the whole affected group) -- that needs the distracting-feint.json/effect-distracting-feint.json two-file companion-effect pattern, which building is outside this card's scope. Left INCOMPLETE for that penalty; the off-guard part needs no fix.
